properties.text: Deposit event data length must equal DEPOSIT_EVENT_LENGTH (576 bytes) or block is rejected.
properties.assertion: forall deposit_log: len(deposit_log.data) != DEPOSIT_EVENT_LENGTH => raise InvalidBlock

properties.text: All five deposit data offsets must match their expected constants or block is invalid.
properties.assertion: forall deposit: offsets(pubkey,wc,amount,sig,index) == (PUBKEY_OFF,WC_OFF,AMT_OFF,SIG_OFF,IDX_OFF)

properties.text: All five deposit field sizes must match expected constants (48,32,8,96,8) or block is invalid.
properties.assertion: forall deposit: sizes(pk,wc,amt,sig,idx) == (PUBKEY_SIZE,WC_SIZE,AMT_SIZE,SIG_SIZE,IDX_SIZE)

properties.text: Extracted deposit data is exactly 192 bytes: pubkey(48)+wc(32)+amount(8)+sig(96)+index(8).
properties.assertion: forall deposit: len(extract_deposit_data(data)) == 192

properties.text: Every deposit data validation failure terminates with InvalidBlock exception, never silently.
properties.assertion: forall deposit, check in validation_checks: fails(check) => raise InvalidBlock

properties.text: Only logs from DEPOSIT_CONTRACT_ADDRESS are processed for deposit requests.
properties.assertion: forall log in processed_logs: log.address == DEPOSIT_CONTRACT_ADDRESS

properties.text: Only logs with topics[0] == DEPOSIT_EVENT_SIGNATURE_HASH are processed as deposits.
properties.assertion: forall log in deposit_logs: len(log.topics) > 0 AND log.topics[0] == DEPOSIT_EVENT_SIG_HASH

properties.text: Deposit requests are processed in receipt_keys order preserving consensus-critical ordering.
properties.assertion: forall block: order(deposit_requests) == order(receipt_keys)

properties.text: Accumulated deposit_requests contains no gaps — every valid deposit is appended contiguously.
properties.assertion: forall block: deposit_requests == concat(extract_deposit_data(log.data) for valid logs)

properties.text: trie_get must return a non-None receipt for every key in receipt_keys.
properties.assertion: forall key in receipt_keys: trie_get(receipts_trie, key) != None

properties.text: Each request is individually SHA-256 hashed before being fed into the outer requests hash.
properties.assertion: forall req in requests: outer_hash.update(sha256(req).digest())

properties.text: Requests hash is computed over requests in list order — reordering changes the hash.
properties.assertion: forall r1,r2: order(r1)!=order(r2) => compute_requests_hash(r1)!=compute_requests_hash(r2)

properties.text: Empty requests list produces sha256 of empty input with no updates applied.
properties.assertion: compute_requests_hash([]) == sha256().digest()

properties.text: RLP encoding order for accounts is strictly (nonce, balance, storage_root, keccak256(code)).
properties.assertion: forall acct: rlp.encode(acct) == rlp((acct.nonce, acct.balance, storage_root, keccak256(acct.code)))

properties.text: EMPTY_ACCOUNT is a frozen constant with nonce=0, balance=0, code=b"".
properties.assertion: EMPTY_ACCOUNT.nonce==0 AND EMPTY_ACCOUNT.balance==0 AND EMPTY_ACCOUNT.code==b""

properties.text: Address type alias is always a 20-byte value (Bytes20).
properties.assertion: forall addr: Address: len(addr) == 20

properties.text: Root and VersionedHash are both 32-byte hash values (Hash32).
properties.assertion: forall r: Root|VersionedHash: len(r) == 32

properties.text: Authorization chain_id must match the target chain for EIP-7702 replay protection.
properties.assertion: forall auth: Authorization: auth.chain_id == CURRENT_CHAIN_ID OR auth.chain_id == 0

properties.text: Authorization (y_parity, r, s) must form a valid ECDSA signature over the authorization tuple.
properties.assertion: forall auth: ecrecover(auth.y_parity, auth.r, auth.s, hash(auth_tuple)) == auth.address

properties.text: Authorization nonce must match the current nonce of the authorizing account.
properties.assertion: forall auth: auth.nonce == state[auth.address].nonce

properties.text: P2P peers are untrusted; all deposit event data from blocks must be fully validated.
properties.assertion: forall block from P2P: validate_all_deposit_data(block) before processing

properties.text: Deposit contract address and event signature hash are trusted immutable constants.
properties.assertion: DEPOSIT_CONTRACT_ADDRESS == CONST AND DEPOSIT_EVENT_SIG_HASH == CONST; immutable at runtime

properties.text: Engine API (EL-CL) is JWT-authenticated; requests hash passed to CL is semi-trusted.
properties.assertion: forall engine_api_call: caller.hasValidJWT == true

properties.text: raw_account_data must be a valid Account instance with nonce, balance, and code fields.
properties.assertion: forall acct: hasattr(acct, 'nonce') AND hasattr(acct, 'balance') AND hasattr(acct, 'code')

properties.text: storage_root must be a 32-byte value representing the Merkle root of account storage trie.
properties.assertion: forall acct: len(acct.storage_root) == 32 AND is_valid_merkle_root(acct.storage_root)

properties.text: After parsing all receipts, deposit_requests contains only data from valid deposit logs.
properties.assertion: forall byte in deposit_requests: exists valid_log such that byte in extract_deposit_data(valid_log.data)

properties.text: compute_requests_hash output is deterministic: same requests always yield the same hash.
properties.assertion: forall r: compute_requests_hash(r) == compute_requests_hash(r) (deterministic)

properties.text: Deposit log data must pass all offset and size checks before field extraction begins.
properties.assertion: forall log: extract_deposit_data(log.data) => all_offsets_valid(log.data) AND all_sizes_valid(log.data)

properties.text: Bloom type alias is always a 256-byte value (Bytes256).
properties.assertion: forall b: Bloom: len(b) == 256

properties.text: Malformed deposit data with wrong offsets cannot bypass validation to inject invalid deposits.
properties.assertion: forall data: any_offset_mismatch(data) => raise InvalidBlock (no partial extraction)

properties.text: Logs from non-deposit contracts cannot inject data into deposit_requests accumulator.
properties.assertion: forall log: log.address != DEPOSIT_CONTRACT_ADDRESS => log not in deposit processing path

properties.text: EIP-7702 Authorization is used only for set-code transactions, not other tx types.
properties.assertion: forall tx: contains_authorization(tx) => tx.type == SET_CODE_TX_TYPE
